lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Circular high-luminance spots are organized into distinct vertical columns spanning the mid-lateral flank, forming a semi-regular 2D grid extending from the pectoral fin origin to the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of blobs, creating a series of anchor nodes at the intersection points across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light upper pixels to a shadowed lower edge, extending linearly towards the tail.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of approximately 10 to 15 small, high-intensity circular clusters concentrated primarily on the lower and central portions of the fin surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A notable notch or truncation is visible on the upper posterior edge of the first dorsal fin. Several reddish-brown pigmented spots, potentially parasitic lesions or abrasions, are present on the upper caudal peduncle and mid-flank.
other_distinctive_markers: The left pectoral fin displays a significantly higher density of smaller, more randomized high-luminance pixel clusters compared to the structured grid pattern of the lateral flank.
